answers.core: Showing "Error: port xxxx already in use." But still running the project with erratic debug output, is an inconsistent behaviour. Displaying a pop-up and asking the user to rectify his mistake, will be convenient to all such users as mentioned before. As this feature will not consume any editor space and is only a few lines of added code to the editor, I think we should not ask the users to install a plug-in for this.
answers.workaround: This enhancement will be useful for everyone who uses more than one editor window at a time. And that should be the case for every multiplayer game. It will be only a few lines of code, but the user has to make the change in the editor.

title: If the "Debug port" is already in use and user presses the "Play button", the editor will display a popup, asking for a different port number.
